title: Shed. GOOMAH
intro: Shed. GOOMAH brings Little Italy to Verbier, blending American favourites with luxurious Italian cuisine. Everything is homemade with a creative twist on classic dishes. Don't miss the entrecôte with bone marrow butter or the taleggio and black truffle arancini. At GOOMAH each bite is crafted with passion and originality.
groupBooking: For groups larger than 12 guests, we offer a private dining room with an intimate homelike appeal. To book this space, please contact us directly via phone or email.
